articles.summary: 6/4/24Each year, American Fuel & Petrochemical Manufacturers (AFPM), the industry's major trade association comprised of 296 member facilities, recognizes companies committed to promoting and improving safety across the industry. Four of Valero's facilities received safety awards during AFPM's annual Safety Awards Event held on May 16, 2024.
articles.title: Valero Wins Four American Fuel & Petrochemical Manufacturers (AFPM) Safety Awards
